text:
nina: hey folks, first week here! i need access to Console (staging) admin + the feature-flag sandbox so i can run a few safe A/B tests for onboarding flow. my okta groups only show console-basic. who should i ping?

omar: welcome! file an access request in IT portal for 'Console (Staging) - Admin' and check the 'feature-flag-sandbox' role. include your manager and okta email. i'll sponsor it if you post your okta id.

nina: thanks omar. manager is kelly. okta id: nina.l@redwood.dev, emp id: 99877. filing now.

ops-bot: Request REQ-11456 created by nina. Requested roles: console-staging-admin, feature-flag-sandbox. Status: Pending manager approval.

kelly: approving now. also please book the short feature-flag security walkthrough (10m) with infra before we add prod-scoped roles. calendar: internal/flag-walkthrough.

ops-bot: REQ-11456 approved by kelly. Assigned to it-oncall. Group propagation ETA 15 minutes.

dev-tools: quick tip: the sandbox UI spins up a temporary segment called 'sandbox-<your-uid>' so you can test without affecting other users. docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/flags-sandbox (internal).

nina: i see console-staging-admin group after ~14m but sandbox tab still hidden. any troubleshooting?

omar: try `rbx auth refresh` and clear cookies, sometimes claim tokens need refresh. if still hidden open a support subtask and tag dev-tools.

ops-bot: REQ-11456 updated: feature-flag-sandbox role added to user account.

nina: refreshed and now i can create sandbox segments. one quick question: what's the safe rollout % for onboarding tests?

kelly: start at 0.5% for behavioral tests, monitor metrics for 24h, then 5% if stable. never use prod for initial experiments.

omar: also note the sandbox toggles reset every 48h. if you need persistence, request a long-lived experiment role from dev-tools.

nina: got it, thanks! can someone show me the small walk-through of the sandbox in a screenshare later today?

omar: happy to — 15:30 PT works for me, i'll DM.

ops-bot: REQ-11456 completed and closed.

nina: confirmed everything working, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
